newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Dagangan to build bunkering facility.
newsitem.headline: Dagangan to build bunkering facility.

text.p: Malaysia's Petronas Dagangan Bhd said on Friday it has signed a joint venture agreement with Westport Holdings Sdn Bhd to build and manage a bunkering facility at West Port in central Selangor state.
The project is estimated to cost 60 million ringgit and is scheduled to begin operations by end-June this year, the petroleum products marketer said in a statement.
Dagangan will hold a 70 percent interest in the joint company, Westport Bunkering Services Sdn Bhd, with Westport holding the remaining 30 percent.
The facility consists of 10 storage tanks, buildings, piepielines, marine loading arms and other related equipment and facilities.
